g.text: -- required + UNIQUE for group; NULL for direct
-- guarantees one DM channel per user pair
CHECK (kind='group' AND name IS NOT NULL
OR kind='direct' AND dm_key IS NOT NULL)
-- NULL until ready; assigned by worker
• aggregated on the bubble: delivered n/m, played n/m
Ephemeral state lives in Redis, not Postgres:
presence:{channel_id} ZSET member "{user_id}:{conn_id}", score = last heartbeat
online = users with a member scored > now − 60 s (multi-tab + crash safe:
a dead api pod stops heart-beating, its entries expire on their own)
ratelimit:{scope}:{key} sliding-window counters (upload, login, signup, dm)
